quizName:
Sign Test
									  					
									  														  					Check how well you know road signs.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns drivers that a side road will cross ahead.

questions.question: What does this yellow sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that traffic will be merging into your lane ahead.

questions.question: What does this yellow pennant-shaped sign mean?
questions.explanation: Pennant-shaped yellow signs mark a no passing zone.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a steep downgrade ahead. Check your brakes before going down.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign shows a steep hill ahead. Slow down and shift to a lower gear to protect your brakes.

questions.question: What does this yellow sign mean?

options.text: Be prepared to stop if the light is flashing.
There is a traffic signal ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a traffic signal ahead.
questions.explanation: A yellow sign with a traffic signal means a traffic signal is ahead. Be ready to respond to it.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: An eight-sided red sign means stop.

questions.question: What does this sign tell you?
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a flagger ahead. Always follow the flagger's directions. Flaggers wear orange or yellow vests and use paddles or flags to direct traffic through work zones.

questions.question: At a school crossing sign, what should you do?

options.text: Always stop, even if there is no stop sign.
Watch for children and be ready to stop.
Always honk when you see children.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for children and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: Pentagonal signs mean you are entering a school zone. Be alert and prepare to stop.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Sharp turn to the right ahead.
Upcoming sharp left and right turns.

questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign shows a winding road ahead. Adjust your speed.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Watch for people crossing the road.

questions.explanation: This orange sign warns drivers that road work is coming. Stay alert for traffic control devices in the work zone.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A red and white triangular sign means you must yield the right-of-way to other vehicles.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers that the divided road is ending. You are now entering a road with traffic moving in both directions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road has curves ahead.

questions.question: When shown on the back of a vehicle, this sign means:

options.text: The vehicle is pulled by an animal.
The vehicle is traveling 25 mph or slower.

questions.correctAnswerText: The vehicle is traveling 25 mph or slower.
questions.explanation: Slow-moving vehicles like bicycles, horse-drawn wagons, or farm equipment display this sign. It warns other drivers that the vehicle will travel at 25 mph or slower.

questions.question: What does this white sign mean?

options.text: Turn left only on a green arrow.
Turn left on a green light when it is safe.
Wait for the solid green light before turning left.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn left on a green light when it is safe.
questions.explanation: A sign that says "yield" means slow down and be ready to stop. Let any vehicles, bicyclists, or pedestrians pass first. Then you can proceed with the sign's directions.

questions.question: What does this sign indicate?

options.text: The height from the road to a bridge or overpass.
The maximum legal height of a vehicle in this state.
The maximum width of a vehicle allowed on the highway.

questions.correctAnswerText: The height from the road to a bridge or overpass.
questions.explanation: This low clearance sign shows the distance from the road to the bottom of a bridge or overpass. In this case, it is 12 feet 6 inches.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. This sign warns of a steep hill coming up. Reduce your speed to avoid collisions and brake damage.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. This sign alerts you that the right lane is ending. Be ready for traffic merging into your lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign show?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that your road ends at an intersection ahead. Slow down and be ready to yield or stop before turning.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead has many turns and curves.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings and alert you to hazards. This sign warns drivers to be careful when it rains because the road becomes slippery and harder to control.

questions.question: What should you do when you see this sign?

options.text: Watch for traffic merging from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for traffic merging from the right.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings and alert you to hazards. This sign warns you that traffic may enter your lane from the right side.

questions.question: What is this bicyclist signaling?
questions.explanation: Bicycles use hand and arm signals because they have no turn signals. When a bicyclist extends their left arm straight out, they are signaling a left turn.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign is placed on vehicles that move slowly.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A round yellow sign means there is a railroad crossing ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulatory signs tell drivers about traffic laws and must be followed. This sign means you cannot turn right where it is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must bear either right or left.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must bear either right or left.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that the road splits and you must choose to go either right or left.

questions.question: What does this sign show?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings and alert you to nearby hazards. This sign warns drivers that another road crosses ahead.

questions.question: What does this white sign mean?

options.text: The crossing is controlled. Drive at your normal speed.
Look and listen, and be ready to stop if needed.
Stop at the tracks and wait for a signal before crossing.

questions.correctAnswerText: Look and listen, and be ready to stop if needed.
questions.explanation: At a railroad crossing, you must look, listen, slow down, and be ready to stop. Wait for any trains to pass before you go.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Stop only if other cars are approaching.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign alerts drivers that bicycles may be crossing the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Cars in the right lane must slow down.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign tells drivers that traffic from the right may merge ahead. Be ready to allow traffic to merge safely.

questions.question: From top to bottom, what is the correct order for traffic lights?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns drivers that a traffic signal is ahead at an intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Reserved parking for persons with disabilities.

questions.correctAnswerText: Reserved parking for persons with disabilities.
questions.explanation: This sign marks parking spaces reserved for vehicles with disability license plates, disabled veteran license plates, or disability parking placards.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn. You cannot turn around and go in the opposite direction where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn in the direction of the arrow. In this case, right turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this warning sign tell drivers?

options.text: The right lane is ending and traffic should merge left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The right lane is ending and traffic should merge left.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns drivers that the number of lanes will decrease ahead and traffic must merge to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Right turn on red light permitted with caution.
All traffic must turn right at next intersection.

questions.explanation: A red circle with a line through a symbol means that action is prohibited. This sign means right turns are not allowed.

questions.question: When you see this sign, what should you do?

options.text: A railroad crossing is ahead. Prepare to stop.
You will always stop at the upcoming railroad crossing.
Stop and wait for a signal before crossing the railroad tracks.

questions.correctAnswerText: A railroad crossing is ahead. Prepare to stop.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a railroad crossing is coming. Look, listen, slow down, and prepare to stop. Wait for trains to pass before you cross the tracks.

questions.question: What does this yellow warning sign mean?

options.text: A school or school crosswalk is ahead.
Slow down, drive with caution, and watch for children.

questions.explanation: This sign is placed on roads near schools to warn drivers to slow down, drive carefully, and watch for children.

questions.question: What does this yellow sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead has many curves.
There is a sharp curve ahead.
The road ahead may be slippery.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead may be slippery.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road may be slippery when wet.

questions.question: What should you do when you see this sign?
questions.explanation: This sign shows that a divided highway is starting. Keep to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a traffic signal is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that a crossroad is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead curves left then right.
The road ahead curves right then left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead curves right then left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road will curve right first, then curve left. Slow down and be prepared for these curves.

questions.question: When you see this sign, you must stop and:

options.text: Check for vehicles only in the direction you plan to go, then proceed.
Let all vehicles that arrive before or after you go first.
Check for traffic in all directions before proceeding.

questions.correctAnswerText: Check for traffic in all directions before proceeding.
questions.explanation: At a stop sign, come to a full stop and look in all directions before you proceed.

questions.question: What does this sign indicate?

options.text: An upcoming construction or maintenance area.

questions.correctAnswerText: An upcoming construction or maintenance area.
questions.explanation: This diamond-shaped sign warns of upcoming construction or maintenance work ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road may be slippery when wet. Drive with caution.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A round sign always means a railroad crossing is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that an intersection is ahead so you can prepare to turn or watch for traffic.

questions.question: What do orange background signs mean?
questions.explanation: Orange signs are only used for construction and maintenance warnings.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Reserved parking for persons with disabilities.

questions.explanation: This sign warns you that two lanes going the same direction will soon become one lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Cars on the right move first.
Let cross traffic pass before proceeding.

questions.correctAnswerText: Let cross traffic pass before proceeding.
questions.explanation: You must yield when you see this sign. Slow down and let other vehicles and pedestrians cross in front of you before you go. Stop if needed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a steep or long hill ahead. The road may also have sharp curves.

questions.question: What must you do when you approach an octagonal sign?
questions.explanation: An octagonal (eight-sided) sign always means stop. Come to a complete stop, check for traffic and pedestrians, and go only when it is safe.

questions.question: What does a pentagon-shaped sign mean?

options.text: School zone or school crossing sign.

questions.correctAnswerText: School zone or school crossing sign.
questions.explanation: A five-sided sign warns drivers about school zones. It may also show where children or pedestrians cross.

questions.question: If you see a sign over your lane with an arrow and the word "only," what should you do?

options.text: Travel in the direction of the arrow.
Look for a destination sign to follow.

questions.correctAnswerText: Travel in the direction of the arrow.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you which direction your lane goes. You must move in the direction shown by the arrow.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for vehicles entering from the side.

questions.explanation: This sign tells you to stay to the right of an island or barrier. The road splits ahead.

questions.question: What does this speed limit sign mean?

options.text: You must travel through the intersection at the posted speed limit.
The maximum speed limit under ideal conditions is 55 mph.
You must not travel below the speed indicated.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum speed limit under ideal conditions is 55 mph.
questions.explanation: This sign shows the highest legal speed for that road. You can drive slower if needed, but you cannot drive faster.

questions.question: What does this stop sign mean?

options.text: You must come to a complete stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must come to a complete stop.
questions.explanation: A stop sign always means stop completely. Stop at the stop line, then check for traffic and pedestrians before going.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers not to make a U-turn. It is a regulatory sign that shows a traffic law you must follow.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the right lane ends ahead. Drivers in that lane must merge to another lane.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You are not allowed to travel in this direction.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are not allowed to travel in this direction.
questions.explanation: Red signs show prohibited actions. If you see this sign, you are going the wrong way. Turn around immediately.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you the divided highway ends ahead. Be ready to change lanes or adjust your position.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Reserved parking for persons with disabilities.

questions.explanation: This sign is placed on one-way streets and roads where you cannot enter. You may see it if you try to go the wrong way on an expressway ramp.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts you to upcoming conditions. It warns you that you are leaving a one-way highway and entering a two-way highway.

questions.question: What does this sign warn drivers about?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts you to conditions immediately ahead. It warns about an upcoming curve to the right.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
You may proceed if the way is clear.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
questions.explanation: This sign marks a one-way road or entrance. If you see this sign, traffic is coming toward you. Do not drive toward it.

questions.question: When you approach a flashing red traffic light, you:

options.text: Are traveling in the wrong direction.
Must treat the intersection as if it is controlled by a stop sign.
May not proceed until it changes to green.

questions.correctAnswerText: Must treat the intersection as if it is controlled by a stop sign.
questions.explanation: Treat a flashing red light like a stop sign. Come to a complete stop at the stop line or before the crosswalk. Yield to all traffic and pedestrians.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You are approaching the end of a divided highway.
You are approaching the beginning of a divided highway.
The road will be slippery ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are approaching the beginning of a divided highway.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a divided highway begins ahead. Stay to the right of the median divider.

questions.question: This sign warns you of a railroad crossing with no signal. What should you do?

options.text: Keep going at the same speed while looking and listening for trains.
Slow down, look both ways, listen for trains, and be ready to stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down, look both ways, listen for trains, and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: At this railroad crossing, you must slow down, look both ways, listen for trains, and be ready to stop if a train is coming. Never try to speed past an oncoming train.

questions.question: This white sign means you cannot pass other vehicles:
questions.explanation: A white rectangular sign is a mandatory rule. This sign means do not pass other vehicles under any circumstances.

questions.question: If you want to turn left at an intersection with this signal, what should you do?

options.text: Turn as long as you let other drivers go first.
Stop and go when it is safe.
Stop completely and stay stopped while the red arrow shows.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop completely and stay stopped while the red arrow shows.
questions.explanation: When a red left arrow shows at a traffic signal, you must come to a complete stop before the intersection. Stay stopped as long as the red arrow is lit.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Side road coming from the left.

questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a yield sign is coming. Start to slow down when you see this warning.

questions.question: What should you do when you see a flashing yellow light at an intersection?

options.text: Stop as quickly as you can.
Stop and go only when the intersection is clear.

questions.explanation: A flashing yellow light means slow down and proceed with caution. You do not need to stop completely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign marks a crosswalk. Watch for pedestrians who may be crossing the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign shows that a divided highway is starting ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down for a curve ahead.
Slow down and do not use your brakes.
Slow down; road is slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down; road is slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead becomes slippery when wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means a stop sign is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This five-sided sign means you are in or near a school zone. Watch for children and drive at posted speed limits.

questions.question: What does this black and yellow sign mean?

options.text: The road to the right is one-way traffic only.
There is a detour to the right because of road construction.
The road ahead turns at a very sharp angle.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead turns at a very sharp angle.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They tell you about dangers ahead. This sign warns you to slow down for a very sharp turn in the road.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Last turn before a toll road.

questions.explanation: Orange signs warn about work zones. If you see orange signs, cones, or barrels, stay alert and be ready for unexpected conditions. This sign tells you a flagger is ahead, and you must follow their directions.

questions.question: What does this sign tell you about the road ahead?

options.text: It turns sharply right, then left.

questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road curves to the right and then to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is a 35 mph speed zone after the curve.
Drive at least 35 mph around the curve ahead.
Slow down to 35 mph or less before the curve ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down to 35 mph or less before the curve ahead.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They tell you about dangers ahead. These signs may show a recommended speed for the curve.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn right. It is against the law to turn right where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn left. It is against the law to turn left where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign indicate?
questions.explanation: Yellow signs with black markings warn about hazards ahead. Round signs are used only to warn about railroad crossings.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Traffic is merging from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic is merging from the right.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They tell you about dangers ahead. This sign warns you to be ready for traffic to merge in from the right.

questions.question: What does a sign with this shape mean?
questions.explanation: A diamond-shaped yellow sign warns of danger ahead. Orange diamond signs warn about dangers in or near work zones.

questions.question: What should you do at this red and white sign?

options.text: Stop and look both ways before proceeding.
Let traffic on the road ahead go before you proceed.
Keep your speed steady and check all directions for traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Let traffic on the road ahead go before you proceed.
questions.explanation: A three-sided yield sign means you must slow down and be ready to stop to let traffic pass. You do not have the right-of-way.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: No left turns are allowed here.
You can turn left only after you stop.
All traffic must turn right at the next intersection.

questions.correctAnswerText: No left turns are allowed here.
questions.explanation: A red circle with a line through it means the action is not allowed. This sign means you cannot turn left.

questions.question: What should you do when you see this sign?

options.text: Look for a train station ahead.
Slow down and let trains pass.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and let trains pass.
questions.explanation: A round sign means a railroad crossing is ahead. This sign tells you to slow down, look, listen, and be ready to stop for trains.

questions.question: What does this white sign mean?

options.text: You should slow down and move to the right lane.
Stay in the right lane if you are driving slower than other traffic.
Slower traffic must exit on the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stay in the right lane if you are driving slower than other traffic.
questions.explanation: White rectangular signs show traffic rules you must follow. This sign means slower drivers should use the right lane to let faster traffic pass on the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. This sign shows where pedestrians cross the road. When you see it, watch for people crossing and let them pass safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You cannot turn when the light is red.

questions.correctAnswerText: You cannot turn when the light is red.
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers that turning right or left on a red light is not allowed at this intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Drive carefully and be ready to stop.
You must come to a complete stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must come to a complete stop.
questions.explanation: The stop sign is the only eight-sided sign on the road. You must come to a complete stop. Do not move until it is safe to go.

questions.question: What information do blue traffic signs provide?
questions.explanation: Blue signs tell you about services for drivers. They show rest areas, food, gas, hospitals, and other help nearby.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign shows there is a pedestrian crosswalk ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road changes direction or gets narrower.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road changes direction or gets narrower.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road is about to curve or narrow. You may see these signs on sharp curves or near narrow bridges.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn. You see this sign at intersections where U-turns are unsafe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must stop for other traffic.
Traffic is merging from another road. Make space for them to merge safely.
Traffic is merging from another road. Stay in the right lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic is merging from another road. Make space for them to merge safely.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that traffic will merge into your lane. Check your mirrors and side. If possible, move to another lane to give merging drivers room.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You can turn left or go straight.

questions.correctAnswerText: You can turn left or go straight.
questions.explanation: This sign shows your lane splits into two directions. You can turn left or continue straight.

questions.question: What does this yellow sign mean?

options.text: A sharp right turn is ahead.
You must turn right in this lane.
You can turn right only on a green arrow.

questions.correctAnswerText: A sharp right turn is ahead.
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs alert you to road conditions ahead. This sign warns of sharp curves and turns.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A sharp right turn is ahead.
A road joins from the right.
The road turns sharply right, then sharply left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road turns sharply right, then sharply left.
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs have black markings. This sign tells you the road will curve sharply right and then sharply left.

questions.question: When you see this yellow sign, what should you do?

options.text: Stop at the crosswalk until the crossing guard signals you to go.
Be ready to stop if children are in the crosswalk.

questions.correctAnswerText: Be ready to stop if children are in the crosswalk.
questions.explanation: A five-sided sign means you are near a school. Watch for children and stop if they are crossing.

questions.question: What does an orange sign like this mean?
questions.explanation: Orange signs warn of construction zones. Drive carefully.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You can travel in either direction in this lane.
Traffic is moving in both directions.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic is moving in both directions.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that traffic is moving in both directions.

questions.question: What type of sign has this shape and color?
questions.explanation: A triangle pointing down is a yield sign. Slow down and be ready to stop. If you must stop, do so at the marked line.
